text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliamentary panel to study on Sunday the financial position of national flag carrier Kuwait Airways Corp.
- Kuwaiti economist expects increase in airfreight prices in the first half of 1997 due to rise in fuel prices.
- Communications Minister Jassem al-Oun says decision to establish a free-trade zone is final. Kuwait is to build the zone on its southern borders.
- Parliament member says panel to reject a bill demanding political rights for Kuwaiti women who do not have the right to vote in parliamentary elections.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange index drops 4.2 points to 1855.6 on Saturday.
